target_customer: Homeowners in the US who want interior and exterior painting, plus local operators joining the franchise network
problem: Home painting is fragmented with uneven pricing and service quality; Craftwork uses software and full time painters to standardize quoting, scheduling and quality.
business_model: Home services company with employed painters and a digital native franchise model; revenue per job

founders.name: Tim Griffin
founders.background_notes: Described by Forerunner as having grown a prior company from $1M to $150M revenue in about 18 months.

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly standard software for quoting, scheduling and operations; the hard part is operational execution of employed crews, not technology.

defensibility.rationale: Painting is easy to enter; advantage would come from local density, operations and brand, none proven at founding.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbent franchises persisted; no evidence found of copying or acquisition as of 2025.

market_need_then: Forerunner cited home services as a roughly $500B industry little changed since online aggregators, with homeowners investing in current homes because of high mortgage rates in 2023.

branding.domain_note: craftwork.com used as the company domain; acquisition history not found

identity.voice_and_tone: Friendly consumer brand aimed at beloved home services, per Forerunner framing

brand_strength.rationale: Clean generic compound name; investors framed it as a consumer brand to build, but no evidence yet of community or press on the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Craftwork is active and has raised a $6M seed led by Forerunner and a $7M Series A led by Slow Ventures in January 2025, helped by a repeat YC founder who had scaled a prior company quickly. Evidence of product market fit is limited to company claimed growth of about 3x a year, so the story is early and the outcome remains open.
notes: Axios reported $4M in July 2023 during YC; Forerunner announced a $6M seed dated 2023-11. Whether these are one round or two is unclear, so only the $6M is recorded. CB Insights shows $17M total and VCBacked $7M; unverified. Axios 2025 article returned 403; Series A seen via a search snippet and a secondary outlet. No dated competitors found for 2023 (CB Insights lists Five Star Painting and Hoist undated). Founders other than Tim Griffin not verified.
